answer: Make cash-out depend on a bonded nursery, not a new key. Earnings stay escrowed until completed jobs are planted in a reputation garden and at least twelve counterparties from more than one settlement reef have countersigned the harvest. Each endorsement locks a jade stake the endorser forfeits if the newcomer is later clustered with a sybil farm. Identities stay cheap to open, but a factory cannot drain the pool without buying many independent stakes and waiting for graph clustering to flag reused counterparties. Detected clones lose the harvest, and every endorser on that reef is slashed.
